workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly the two completed same-date Reading Notes and produced two bounded Research Objects. Q-20260910-01 concludes that high-impact authority must separate scope belief, externally verifiable target/scope facts, and permission to create effects; a second model is not an independent control when it inherits the actor's unverified narrative premise, so consequential execution needs call-time authority and at least one enforcement path able to disagree with the actor. Governed abortability and explicit audit-coverage evidence are additional independent defenses. Q-20260910-02 concludes that self-evolving procedures require a candidate/active state boundary: a model may propose structural change, but activation should consume evidence not used to generate the proposal, preserve explicit candidate identity, retain rejected state as non-executable evidence, and support freshness/rollback. Held-out validation is a meaningful minimum gate but is not full model/organizational independence or a production-safety proof. Both Research Objects are ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true and publication_authorized=false. No article drafting, Production staging, cover generation or Publication was performed.
workResult_zh: Skill 04 严格只消费两份同日 Completed Reading Note，并生成两份有界 Research Object。Q-20260910-01 的结论是，高影响执行权必须把 Scope Belief、外部可核验的 Target/Scope Fact 与产生 Effect 的 Permission 分成不同状态；如果第二个模型继承 Actor 的未核验叙事前提，它并不构成真正独立的控制，因此关键执行需要 Call-time Authority，以及至少一条能够与 Actor 意见相反并实际阻断 Effect 的 Enforcement Path；Governed Abortability 与显式 Audit Coverage Evidence 也是独立防线。Q-20260910-02 的结论是，自演化 Procedure 必须存在 Candidate/Active 状态边界：模型可以提出结构变更，但激活必须消费未用于生成 Proposal 的证据，固定 Candidate 身份，把 Rejected State 保留为不可执行证据，并支持 Freshness/rollback。Held-out Validation 是有意义的最低准入门，但不等于完整的 Model/Organizational Independence，也不构成 Production Safety 证明。两份 Research Object 均为 ReadyForProduction、production_input_authorized=true、publication_authorized=false。未执行文章写作、Production Staging、题图生成或 Publication。
